# Plarix

> Plarix finds and files the manufacturer warranty claims, parts credits, labor
> reimbursements, and rebates that HVAC and plumbing contractors have already
> earned but never collected. Free diagnostic. Flat monthly fee. No long-term
> contract.

## Pages
- [Home](https://plarix.dev/): what Plarix does and how it works.
- [Pricing](https://plarix.dev/pricing): public, flat-fee pricing structure.
- [FAQ](https://plarix.dev/faq): common questions about process, contract
  terms, and platform integrations (ServiceTitan, Jobber, FieldEdge).
